rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AB grading and gives a plausible ICM/TE description, but it over-interprets image details such as peripheral debris/polar body and makes a somewhat assertive claim of Day-5 developmental delay from limited visual information.
Thoroughly integrates age, PCOS, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from morphology and patient factors to prognosis, though some quantitative deductions appear somewhat subjective and cumulative penalties may be stronger than the evidence supports.

Mostly aligned on general IVF principles, but includes several recommendations that are not routinely guideline-supported or are overstated for this case, such as ERA after one failed transfer, routine PGT-A rationale in a 30-year-old, luteal estradiol/IM progesterone escalation based mainly on 7 mm lining, and DHEA suggestion in PCOS.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, and future-cycle planning, but some recommendations are more speculative than standard and would need clinician-specific tailoring.
